questions.stem: The figure shows a rectangle with length \((3x^2+x-2)\,\mathrm{cm}\) and width \((x-1)\,\mathrm{cm}\). Find its perimeter in terms of \(x\).
questions.stemZh: 圖中的長方形長 \((3x^2+x-2)\,\mathrm{cm}\)，闊 \((x-1)\,\mathrm{cm}\)。以 \(x\) 表示其周界。
questions.solution: The perimeter is twice the sum of adjacent sides: \[\begin{gathered}2[(3x^2+x-2)+(x-1)] \\ =6x^2 +4x -6\end{gathered}\]. Thus the answer is \((6x^2+4x-6)\,\mathrm{cm}\).
questions.solutionZh: 周界為兩相鄰邊之和的兩倍：\[\begin{gathered}2[(3x^2+x-2)+(x-1)] \\ =6x^2 +4x -6\end{gathered}\]，所以答案為 \((6x^2+4x-6)\,\mathrm{cm}\)。
questions.sourceZh: S1/polynomials/polynomial review.pdf · 第9題

questions.stem: Kenny originally has \((3x+2y)\) apps. He uninstalls \((x+8y)\) apps, then installs \((2x-12y)\) apps. How many apps does he have now?
questions.stemZh: Kenny 原有 \((3x+2y)\) 個應用程式。他解除安裝 \((x+8y)\) 個，再安裝 \((2x-12y)\) 個。現在有多少個？
questions.solution: Subtract the uninstalled number and add the installed number: \[\begin{gathered}(3x+2y) -(x+8y) \\ +(2x-12y) =4x -18y\end{gathered}\].
questions.solutionZh: 原數量減去解除安裝數，再加上新安裝數：\[\begin{gathered}(3x+2y) -(x+8y) \\ +(2x-12y) =4x -18y\end{gathered}\]。

questions.stem: Simplify \(\frac{(-2x^2y^3)^3}{8x^7y}\).
questions.solution: The odd power retains the negative sign: \[\begin{gathered}(-2x^2y^3)^3 = \\ -8x^6y^9\end{gathered}\]. Dividing by \(8x^7y\) gives \(-\frac{y^8}{x}\), for \(x,y\ne0\).
questions.solutionZh: 奇數次冪保留負號：\[\begin{gathered}(-2x^2y^3)^3 = \\ -8x^6y^9\end{gathered}\]。再除以 \(8x^7y\) 得 \(-\frac{y^8}{x}\)（\(x,y\ne0\)）。

questions.stem: If \[\begin{gathered}(x^my^2)^5 \\ =x^{10}y^n\end{gathered}\], where \(m,n\) are positive integers, find \(m,n\).
questions.stemZh: 若 \[\begin{gathered}(x^my^2)^5 \\ =x^{10}y^n\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(m,n\) 為正整數，求 \(m,n\)。
questions.solution: Expand the left side as \(x^{5m}y^{10}\). Comparing exponents gives \(5m=10\) and \(n=10\), so \(m=2,n=10\).

questions.stem:
Mr Pang teaches \((x+2)\) classes, with \((2x+7)\) students in each class. He buys each student a gift costing HKD \(2x\).
(a) Express the total cost in terms of \(x\).
(b) Find the total cost when each gift costs HKD10.
questions.stemZh:
彭老師任教 \((x+2)\) 班，每班有 \((2x+7)\) 位學生，並為每人買一份售價港幣 \(2x\) 元的禮物。
(a) 以 \(x\) 表示總開支。
(b) 若每份禮物售價港幣 10 元，求總開支。
questions.solution:
(a) Number of students is \((x+2)(2x+7)\). Multiply by the unit price: \[\begin{gathered}2x(x+2)(2x+7) =4x^3 \\ +22x^2 +28x\end{gathered}\]. Total cost is HKD \((4x^3+22x^2+28x)\).
(b) From \(2x=10\), \(x=5\). There are 7 classes of 17 students, so the cost is HKD \((7)(17)(10)=1190\).
questions.sourceZh: S1/polynomials/polynomial review.pdf · 第18題

questions.stem:
The figure shows an isosceles triangle \(ABC\) with \(AB=BC\). Its side \(AC\) is \((2x+4y)\,\mathrm{cm}\) and its perimeter is \((8x+10y)\,\mathrm{cm}\).
(a) Express \(AB\) in terms of \(x,y\).
(b) Find all side lengths when \(x=3,y=1\).
(c) Emily claims that the triangle is equilateral when \(x=1,y=1\). Do you agree? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
圖中的等腰三角形 \(ABC\) 滿足 \(AB=BC\)。邊 \(AC\) 長 \((2x+4y)\,\mathrm{cm}\)，周界為 \((8x+10y)\,\mathrm{cm}\)。
(a) 以 \(x,y\) 表示 \(AB\)。
(b) 當 \(x=3,y=1\) 時，求三邊長。
(c) Emily 聲稱當 \(x=1,y=1\) 時，三角形為等邊三角形。你是否同意？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) Since \(AB=BC\), \[\begin{gathered}2AB =(8x+10y) \\ -(2x+4y) =6x +6y\end{gathered}\]. Thus \[\begin{gathered}AB \\ =(3x+3y)\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\].
(b) \[\begin{gathered}AB =BC \\ =(3\cdot3+3\cdot1)\,\mathrm{cm} \\ =12\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\], while \[\begin{gathered}AC \\ =(2\cdot3+4\cdot1)\,\mathrm{cm} \\ =10\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\].
(c) Agree. At \(x=y=1\), \[\begin{gathered}AB =BC \\ =6\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\] and \(AC=6\,\mathrm{cm}\), so all three sides are equal.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 由 \(AB=BC\)，得 \[\begin{gathered}2AB =(8x+10y) \\ -(2x+4y) =6x +6y\end{gathered}\]，故 \[\begin{gathered}AB \\ =(3x+3y)\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\]。
(b) \[\begin{gathered}AB =BC \\ =(3\cdot3+3\cdot1)\,\mathrm{cm} \\ =12\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\]，\[\begin{gathered}AC \\ =(2\cdot3+4\cdot1)\,\mathrm{cm} \\ =10\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\]。
(c) 同意。當 \(x=y=1\)，\[\begin{gathered}AB =BC \\ =6\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\] 且 \(AC=6\,\mathrm{cm}\)，三邊相等，故為等邊三角形。

questions.stem: The remainder when a polynomial \(f(x)\) is divided by \(4x-6\) is \(8\). Find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(3-2x\).
questions.stemZh: 多項式 \(f(x)\) 被 \(4x-6\) 除時餘式為 \(8\)。求 \(f(x)\) 被 \(3-2x\) 除時的餘式。
questions.solution: Both \(4x-6=0\) and \(3-2x=0\) give \(x=\frac{3}{2}\). The divisors share the same root, so both remainders equal \(f(\frac{3}{2})=8\).
questions.solutionZh: \(4x-6=0\) 與 \(3-2x=0\) 都給 \(x=\frac{3}{2}\)。兩個除式有同一個 root，所以餘式同為 \(f(\frac{3}{2})=8\)。。

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)=3x^2-kx-2\), where \(k\) is a constant. If \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(3x+1\), find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x-k\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \(f(x)=3x^2-kx-2\)，其中 \(k\) 為常數。若 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(3x+1\) 整除，求 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x-k\) 除時的餘式。
questions.solution: The factor \(3x+1\) gives \(x=-\frac{1}{3}\): \[ f\left(-\frac{1}{3}\right)=\frac{1}{3}+\frac{k}{3}-2=0, \] so \(k=5\). The required remainder is \(f(5)=48\).

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)=x^2-hx+k\), where \(h\) and \(k\) are constants. If \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(2x-h\), find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(2x+h\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \(f(x)=x^2-hx+k\)，其中 \(h,k\) 為常數。若 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(2x-h\) 整除，求 \(f(x)\) 被 \(2x+h\) 除時的餘式。
questions.solution: Since \(2x-h\) is a factor, \(f(\frac h2)=0\), giving \(k=\frac{h^2}{4}\). The root of \(2x+h\) is \(-\frac h2\), hence \[ f\left(-\frac h2\right)=\frac{h^2}{4}+\frac{h^2}{2}+\frac{h^2}{4}=h^2. \]
questions.solutionZh: \(2x-h\) 是因式，故 \(f(\frac h2)=0\)，所以 \[ \frac{h^2}{4}-\frac{h^2}{2}+k=0\Rightarrow k=\frac{h^2}{4}. \] 除式 \(2x+h\) 的 root 是 \(-\frac h2\)，故 \[ f\left(-\frac h2\right)=\frac{h^2}{4}+\frac{h^2}{2}+\frac{h^2}{4}=h^2. \] 。

questions.stem: Let \(p(x)=ax^4+4x^2-3x+b\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are non-zero constants. When \(p(x)\) is divided by \(3x-2\), the remainder is \(7\). Find the remainder when \(p(x)\) is divided by \(3x+2\).
questions.hint: The roots of \(3x-2\) and \(3x+2\) are \(\frac{2}{3}\) and \(-\frac{2}{3}\).
questions.solution: The roots of \(3x-2\) and \(3x+2\) are \(\frac{2}{3}\) and \(-\frac{2}{3}\). The even-power terms agree, while \(-3x\) increases by \(4\). Thus \[ p\left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)=p\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)+4=11. \]
questions.solutionZh: \(3x-2\) 與 \(3x+2\) 的 root 分別是 \(\frac{2}{3}\) 與 \(-\frac{2}{3}\)。偶次項在兩個 input 的值相同；一次項 \(-3x\) 則由 \(-2\) 變為 \(2\)，增加 \(4\)。所以 \[ p\left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)=p\left(\frac{2}{3}\right)+4=11. \] 。
